character_identity_locks.appearance_summary: Aria is a capable adult technician in their 30s-40s with a practical, no-nonsense appearance. Medium build, alert and composed demeanor suited to technical work under pressure.
distinguishing_features: Short, functional hair requiring minimal maintenance
character_identity_locks.name: ARIA
character_identity_locks.wardrobe_summary: Practical work attire: sturdy pants, fitted long-sleeve shirt or work jacket, utility belt or tool-carrying setup. Functional footwear suitable for climbing and technical work. Layers appropriate for night outdoor conditions.

character_identity_locks.appearance_summary: Noah is a technical operator in his late 20s to early 30s with an athletic, lean build. He has short, practical dark hair and minimal facial hair. His face is alert and focused, with an approachable, competent demeanor suited to hands-on technical work.
character_identity_locks.name: NOAH
character_identity_locks.wardrobe_summary: Functional work clothing appropriate for technical operations: fitted jeans or work pants, a long-sleeve button-up shirt or technical crew shirt in neutral tones (gray, navy, or earth tones), and practical footwear. Layers that suggest readiness for outdoor catwalk work in night conditions.

frames.notes: Wind lashes the catwalk. The canvas tool bag swings in harsh gusts. Aria positions the lantern, securing it with her boot. Noah works the antenna clamp onto the rail, concentrating. A siren rises and cuts out somewhere in the valley below.

overlay.blocking_indicator: Aria downstage left, bracing lantern with boot. Noah downstage right, clamping portable antenna to rusted rail. Canvas tool bag swinging between them in the wind. Lantern light pools on the catwalk; town lights visible below in the distance.
overlay.camera_angle: Level, slightly high to show catwalk and town below
overlay.camera_indicator: Level, slightly high to show catwalk and town below; movement=Static; lens=35mm equivalent
overlay.edit_intent: Establish the environment, scale, and danger. Show both characters at work, the lantern as the primary light source, and the town below as context. The siren sound design should underscore the emergency. Hold long enough for the viewer to register the exposed location and the wind.
